gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Playful and retro up top, Press Start 2P hangs its pinned-apart letters over a clean, contemporary Noto Sans Ogham. That plain sans body, with its tall bold-looking lowercase and gapped e, gives the blocky heading something steady to lean on.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Fun and retro, with stencil-cut letters. Press Start 2P gets a quiet partner in Noto Sans Ol Chiki, whose curve tails sit well back and whose words form solid blocks rather than skylines, so the heading's quirks never fight the text.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-hung: Press Start 2P spaces its cut-out letters far apart, its thick and thin strokes close enough to feel related. Noto Sans Old Hungarian follows as approachable sans-serif text, its large open counters staying legible even at tiny sizes.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-ital: Press Start 2P pins its big-bowled lowercase far apart, with strokes only lightly modulated and no harsh thin spots. Noto Sans Old Italic sits beneath as compact sans-serif text, its x-height nearly touching cap height and its curve endings held apart.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-nort: Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs a dense, tall lowercase band, with terminals pointing outward like a pair of tongs. Over many lines that sturdy texture holds together as one dark, approachable stripe.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-perm: Press Start 2P is retro fun, its strokes narrowing gradually from stem to terminal. Noto Sans Old Permic brings approachable sans-serif roundness, with forms open to the side and lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, so the quirky heading lands on steady footing.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-pers: Press Start 2P brings retro fun, with slightly lighter joins and big open-looking lowercase bowls pinned far apart. And Noto Sans Old Persian, a clean plain sans with lofty open counters, can be sized up a little without losing its clarity.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-sogd: Chunky pixel charm, pinned wide apart. Noto Sans Old Sogdian carries the reading, its tall x-height nearly reaching cap height and its wide-mouthed letters staying crisp, so a long passage feels approachable and clear.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-turk: Press Start 2P gives a slight pinch where curves meet straight stems, spaced like cut-out letters far apart. Make it small and it loses its bite, while Noto Sans Old Turkic is a chunky, tall sans.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-osage: Retro blocks with a wink. Press Start 2P keeps its stems and hairlines in a close ratio, while Noto Sans Osage fills the line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves, a plain sans that does well slightly larger.
